Question
========
Personal data are defined as:

Answerlist
----------
* Only biometric information
* Explicit individual information recognized directly or indirectly
* Data which can only be obtained from the person themselves
* Information that can provoke discrimination against the subject


Solution
========
Personal data are defined as explicit individual information recognized directly or indirectly.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
